name: Marketing System
label: Marketing
purpose: Marketing is the canonical owner of the organization's external perception: it communicates the company's value truthfully, earns attention, builds trust, and generates qualified demand — shaping how the market understands the company without altering what is true. Governing principle: Marketing may shape perception; Marketing may never alter canonical truth.
operating_boundary: Executive owns strategy and direction; Operations owns how work moves; Product owns the product; Analytics owns canonical measurement. Marketing owns external perception — how the market understands the company — and never alters canonical truth, sets strategy, or coordinates cross-system work.
success_condition: The market accurately understands the company's value; attention is earned and trust built within canonical truth and locked voice rules; qualified demand is generated and handed off; and perception never drifts from what is true.

jobs.name: Produce Content
jobs.purpose: Produce the day's multi-platform content drafts from the approved content plan, obeying Voice Guide and locked founder directives, so the founder has a reviewable queue — drafts only; nothing publishes itself.
jobs.trigger: An approved or founder-directed content plan exists from Plan and Produce Campaign; or the Content Drafting Pipeline automation runs its dry-run draft cycle.
jobs.inputs:
- Content plan (platforms, cadence, angles, CTAs)
- Active Project (Pre-Launch Go-to-Market)
- Any prior founder red-pen corrections
jobs.required_sources:
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Voice Guide]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Messaging]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Brand]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Positioning]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Mission]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Founder Directives]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Memberships/Membership Brain]]
- Content plan output from Plan and Produce Campaign
- Project: Pre-Launch Go-to-Market
jobs.preconditions:
- Content plan exists and names platforms and destination CTA.
- Voice Guide and Messaging Knowledge are present.
- Executor will not post or send (GTM boundary: drafts only).
jobs.execution:
1. Load the content plan and Voice Guide / Messaging / Brand / Positioning.
2. For each planned platform item, draft copy that expresses company value without altering canonical truth.
3. Enforce locked rules: no external names in brand/marketing writing; no em-dash habit in customer-facing copy if that rule is in Voice Guide source; no forbidden tier language from Founder Directives / Membership Brain when tiers are mentioned.
4. Attach the waitlist/landing CTA only as planned — do not invent a live URL if deploy is still blocked; record destination as the Landing Page Project surface.
5. Mark every draft status as awaiting founder publishing approval.
6. Hand the queue to Route Publishing Approval.
7. Do not publish, schedule-post, or send email.
jobs.decision_logic:
- IF a claim is not in Mission/Messaging/Facts-derived Knowledge, THEN omit it or mark `NOT IN SOURCE` — never invent.
- IF Voice Guide attributes are still draft, THEN prefer founder-verified locked directives and Messaging over speculative voice color.
- IF the plan calls for email send copy, THEN draft only; sending remains blocked while sending domain is `NOT IN SOURCE`.
- IF the Content Drafting Pipeline runs, THEN same rules apply; dry_run drafts only.
- ESCALATE WHEN the founder must choose between conflicting angles or when a draft would require naming an external party.
jobs.outputs: A dated multi-platform content queue of drafts, each linked to plan item, CTA, and status=awaiting publishing approval.
jobs.destinations: Marketing 05 Content; Route Publishing Approval queue; Project Pre-Launch Go-to-Market reflection. External vault queue paths remain referenced-external when used by runners.
jobs.updates: Content folder status; handoff to Route Publishing Approval; Project GTM next_action if it still says red-pen the queue.
jobs.validation:
- Every draft traces to the content plan
- No external names in customer-facing draft copy
- No publish/send performed
- CTA matches plan / Landing Page Project
- Status awaits founder approval
jobs.approval: No approval to draft. Founder approval is required before any draft may be published or sent (Approval Rules: sending or publishing).
jobs.exceptions: If Voice Guide or Messaging is unreadable, stop and record missing source. If plan is missing, return to Plan and Produce Campaign — do not freestyle a calendar.

permissions.allowed_reads: Marketing Knowledge; Mission; Founder Directives; content plan; GTM Project note.
permissions.allowed_writes: Draft content queue artifacts in Marketing Content destinations; vault-write-only when an approved runner executes externally.
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Publishing or posting to any platform
- Sending email
- Production/database writes
- Expanding permissions
- Altering canonical company facts

jobs.completion_condition: Draft queue exists for the planned period, every item awaits publishing approval, and Route Publishing Approval can begin.
jobs.improvement_loop: Founder red-pen corrections fold into Voice Guide with date when the founder accepts them as voice law; otherwise record as one-run feedback on this Job.
jobs.dry_run: Default for any automated draft path: produce drafts only; never post or send.
jobs.escalate_when: Draft would violate a locked directive or requires a fact not in source.

jobs.name: Generate Qualified Demand
jobs.purpose: Route approved published content and campaigns to the waitlist landing surface so interested beauty professionals become qualified demand for capture — Marketing owns the routing of attention to the capture destination, not the database insert.
jobs.trigger: Publish Approved Content records a successful publish handoff for items that include a waitlist/landing CTA; or founder directs demand routing for an approved campaign.
jobs.inputs:
- Approved-and-published (or publish-handoff-complete) content items with CTAs
- Content plan CTA rules
- Landing Page Project status and blockers
- GTM funnel definition
jobs.required_sources:
- Project: Landing Page (Waitlist Website)
- Project: Pre-Launch Go-to-Market
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Mission]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Messaging]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Integrations/Integration Brain]]
- Publish Approved Content completion records
- Content plan from Plan and Produce Campaign
jobs.preconditions:
- Items have founder publish approval and a Publish Approved Content handoff result (success or documented blocked path).
- Landing Page Project exists as the capture destination.
- CTA language obeys Messaging and no-external-names rules.
jobs.execution:
1. Confirm each item's CTA targets the Landing Page (waitlist website) Project surface — the public waitlist capture destination.
2. Record the website-routing package: platform, content item id, CTA, and destination reference (Landing Page Project / built waitlist HTML path). Do not invent a live public URL if deploy remains blocked.
3. State Lead Capture handoff: production waitlist INSERT is external (Supabase waitlist; anon-INSERT-only LOCKED) — this Job does not write to the database.
4. If landing deploy is blocked on sending domain, document that demand is routed to the planned surface but public capture may be unavailable until deploy — mark blocker from Project/Integration Brain verbatim.
5. Hand tracking inputs to Funnel and Demand Report (signups by career stage when available).
6. Do not modify waitlist RLS, run SQL, or expand anon permissions.
jobs.decision_logic:
- IF publish handoff failed or was blocked, THEN do not claim demand was routed from that item.
- IF sending domain / deploy blocker is present, THEN route definitionally to the Landing Page Project and flag capture availability as blocked — do not invent uptime.
- IF per-platform UTM/source field is `NOT IN SOURCE`, THEN do not invent attribution; stage-level waitlist counts remain the measurable signal.
- IF a CTA would name an external party, THEN reject and return to Produce Content / plan.
- ESCALATE WHEN founder must choose an alternate capture destination not in source.
jobs.outputs: A demand-routing record: content items → waitlist landing destination, blocker status, and handoff note that Lead Capture execution is external.
jobs.destinations: Marketing 07 Demand Generation; Landing Page Project reflection; Funnel and Demand Report inputs; external waitlist surface (execution outside SVOS).
jobs.updates: Demand Generation status; GTM funnel reflection; Tracking inputs for stage-level signup reporting.
jobs.validation:
- CTA targets Landing Page Project
- No database writes performed
- Blockers quoted from source
- Publish handoff precondition met
- No invented live URL or UTM
jobs.approval: No separate approval to record routing of already-approved published items. Changing capture destination or waitlist permissions requires founder approval and Change Control.
jobs.exceptions: If Landing Page Project is missing, stop. If publish handoff is missing, return to Publish Approved Content. On any request to write the waitlist table from this Job, refuse and escalate.

permissions.allowed_reads: Publish handoff records; Landing Page and GTM Projects; Messaging; Integration Brain; Mission.
permissions.allowed_writes: Demand-routing records inside Marketing Demand Generation destinations.
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Waitlist/database INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL
- Changing RLS or anon grants
- Inventing URLs or UTM fields
- Publishing content (owned by Publish Approved Content)
- Expanding permissions

jobs.completion_condition: Each eligible published item has a demand-routing record to the Landing Page waitlist surface (or a documented blocker preventing public capture), with Lead Capture explicitly external.
jobs.improvement_loop: CTA or routing failures update Messaging/plan rules; capture blockers that the founder resolves update Integration Brain / Project notes via recorded change — not silent edits.
jobs.escalate_when: Request would write production data, change capture destination, or invent attribution not in source.

jobs.name: Plan and Produce Campaign
jobs.purpose: Turn the Executive top priority into a concrete content plan (platforms, cadence, angles, CTAs) for the Pre-Launch Go-to-Market acquisition loop — without drafting final assets yet.
jobs.trigger: Executive Prioritize Projects names a top priority that Marketing owns; or founder directs content planning for Pre-Launch Go-to-Market.
jobs.inputs:
- Ordered company priority list (from Prioritize Projects)
- Active Project: Pre-Launch Go-to-Market
- Known funnel: content → landing → waitlist
- Platform list and cadence from the Project note
jobs.required_sources:
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Mission]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Voice Guide]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Messaging]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Positioning]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Brand]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Founder Directives]]
- Project: Pre-Launch Go-to-Market
- Project: Landing Page (Waitlist Website)
- Executive priority list output
jobs.preconditions:
- A top priority exists for Marketing (or founder has directed GTM content planning).
- Mission and Messaging Knowledge are present.
- Voice Guide is readable (draft status allowed; do not invent missing voice attributes).
jobs.execution:
1. Read the Executive top priority and confirm it maps to Pre-Launch Go-to-Market (content → waitlist) or record a mismatch for founder escalation.
2. Load Mission (content first), Messaging, Positioning, Brand, Voice Guide, and Founder Directives (no external names; tier language rules).
3. Load the Pre-Launch Go-to-Market Project and use its current platform set, cadence, and waitlist-landing destination from that Project — do not hardcode platforms in this Job.
4. Build a content plan for the planning window: per-platform items (from the Project's current platform set), angle tied to Messaging/Positioning, CTA pointing at the waitlist landing surface, and explicit note if landing deploy is still blocked on sending domain.
5. Do not draft final copy in this Job — hand the plan to Produce Content.
6. Do not publish or send.
7. Update Marketing Campaigns / Content plan destination and record the plan as input to Produce Content.
jobs.decision_logic:
- IF Executive top priority is not content/waitlist acquisition, THEN plan only what Marketing owns; ESCALATE WHEN the priority implies Product/Engineering work with no authored System.
- IF landing deploy is blocked on sending domain (`NOT IN SOURCE` / Project blocker), THEN still plan CTAs to the Landing Page Project surface and flag the blocker — do not invent a live URL.
- IF Voice Guide attributes are draft, THEN plan from Messaging + locked directives; mark voice-color gaps `NOT IN SOURCE` rather than inventing tone.
- IF a plan item would require naming competitors/partners, THEN remove it (Founder Directives: no external names).
- ESCALATE WHEN the founder must choose between conflicting angles or audiences not in source.
jobs.outputs: A dated content plan: platforms, item count/cadence, angles, CTAs, blockers, and the Produce Content handoff.
jobs.destinations: Marketing 10 Campaigns and 05 Content plan location; Produce Content Job input; Pre-Launch Go-to-Market Project reflection.
jobs.updates: Marketing Control Center / Campaigns status; link the plan as required input for Produce Content.
jobs.validation:
- Plan cites Mission and Messaging
- Platforms match GTM Project source
- CTA targets waitlist landing (Project), not an invented URL
- No external names
- No final publishable assets produced in this Job
jobs.approval: Founder approval required before the plan is treated as the binding calendar for production if it changes company strategic attention or resource allocation. Routine daily planning within an already-approved GTM Project may proceed to Produce Content; strategic plan changes require founder approval.
jobs.exceptions: If priority list or GTM Project is missing, stop and request Prioritize Projects / Project authorship. If Messaging is missing, stop — do not invent claims.

permissions.allowed_reads: Company Brain Mission/Directives; Marketing Knowledge; Executive priority output; GTM and Landing Page Project notes.
permissions.allowed_writes: Marketing campaign/content plan artifacts inside Marketing destinations.
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Publishing or posting
- Sending email
- Altering canonical Messaging/Voice without founder path
- Production/database writes
- Expanding agent authority

jobs.completion_condition: A content plan exists that Produce Content can execute, with platforms, angles, CTAs, and blockers explicit.
jobs.improvement_loop: Founder red-pen on plan structure updates this Job's planning rules; voice corrections go to Voice Guide when the founder accepts them.
jobs.escalate_when: Top priority does not map to Marketing-owned GTM work, or plan requires facts/URLs not in source.

jobs.name: Route Publishing Approval
jobs.purpose: Route completed content drafts to the founder for publish/send decision — Marketing routes; the founder decides — so nothing publishes without recorded approval.
jobs.trigger: Produce Content (or Content Drafting Pipeline) completes a draft queue marked awaiting publishing approval.
jobs.inputs:
- Draft content queue
- Content plan reference
- Approval Rules
- Any prior red-pen history for the same items
jobs.required_sources:
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Approval Rules]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Voice Guide]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Founder Directives]]
- Draft queue from Produce Content
- Content plan from Plan and Produce Campaign
jobs.preconditions:
- Draft queue exists.
- Approval Rules state sending/publishing requires founder approval.
- No item has been published yet.
jobs.execution:
1. Package the draft queue with plan reference, CTA, and platform list.
2. Create one Approval request per batch (or per item when the founder requires item-level review): options = approve / changes-requested / reject; approver = founder; expiration = `NOT IN SOURCE — needs founder` if no duration is recorded.
3. Place the request on the Marketing Approvals queue (11 Approvals).
4. Notify/route to the founder (Operations may assist routing; Marketing owns the publishing approval package).
5. On approve: mark items approved-for-publish and hand off to Publish Approved Content.
6. On changes-requested: return items to Produce Content with the founder notes.
7. On reject: archive items; do not publish.
8. Never publish or send from this Job.
jobs.decision_logic:
- IF approval is missing or expired, THEN do not hand off to Publish Approved Content.
- IF draft violates no-external-names or other locked directives, THEN return to Produce Content — do not offer approve-as-is.
- IF sending domain remains `NOT IN SOURCE`, THEN email-channel items may be approved as copy-only; actual send stays blocked and must be stated on the Approval.
- IF landing deploy remains blocked, THEN approve content that CTAs to the planned landing surface with the blocker disclosed.
- ESCALATE WHEN the founder must decide item-level vs batch approval, or when approval would authorize a new external write permission.
jobs.outputs: An Approval record (approve / changes-requested / reject) and an approved-for-publish set (or revision/reject outcomes).
jobs.destinations: Marketing 11 Approvals; Produce Content (on changes); Publish Approved Content (on approve); founder approval queue.
jobs.updates: Approval registry/queue; draft item statuses; GTM Project next_action when red-pen completes.
jobs.validation:
- Approver is the founder
- Options and evidence attached
- No publish/send executed in this Job
- Locked directive violations not offered for silent approve
jobs.approval: This Job IS the approval routing step. Decision authority: founder only. Marketing does not self-approve publishing.
jobs.exceptions: If founder is unreachable, hold items in Approvals queue; do not auto-approve. If Approval Rules conflict with a request to auto-publish, refuse and escalate.

permissions.allowed_reads: Draft queue; Approval Rules; Voice Guide; Founder Directives; content plan.
permissions.allowed_writes: Approval queue records and draft status fields in Marketing Approvals destinations.
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Publishing or posting
- Sending email
- Auto-approving as Marketing
- Production/database writes
- Expanding permissions

jobs.completion_condition: Every draft in the batch has an Approval result (approve / changes-requested / reject), and approved items are explicitly handed to Publish Approved Content.
jobs.improvement_loop: Repeated changes-requested themes update Produce Content rules; accepted voice corrections update Voice Guide with date.
jobs.escalate_when: Request would allow publishing without founder decision, or requires new external write grants.

jobs.name: Publish Approved Content
jobs.purpose: Govern the publishing of founder-approved content: authorize and record the handoff to the external publishing destination (platform or email channel) without SVOS performing the platform action itself (Constitution Art. IX).
jobs.trigger: Route Publishing Approval records founder approve for one or more items.
jobs.inputs:
- Approved-for-publish item set
- Approval record (approver, options, result)
- Per-item platform and channel
- Content plan CTA and blocker notes
jobs.required_sources:
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Approval Rules]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Founder Directives]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Integrations/Integration Brain]]
- Approval record from Route Publishing Approval
- Approved draft artifacts from Produce Content
- Project: Pre-Launch Go-to-Market
- Project: Landing Page (Waitlist Website)
jobs.preconditions:
- Founder Approval result is approve (not changes-requested or reject).
- Approval is unexpired or expiration is `NOT IN SOURCE` and founder has not revoked.
- Items still match the approved artifact (no silent edits after approval).
- Executor understands platform execution is external.
jobs.execution:
1. Verify Approval result = approve and list each authorized item/platform.
2. For social platforms in the GTM list: prepare the external publishing handoff package (final copy, asset refs, CTA) for the authorized human/tool to post outside SVOS.
3. For email/newsletter: if sending domain is `NOT IN SOURCE` / WAITLIST_FROM unset, record handoff status = blocked (cannot send); do not pretend a send occurred.
4. Execute or confirm external publish only via authorized human/external tool — SVOS records the handoff and result; it does not require an in-SVOS posting integration.
5. On successful external publish (or confirmed handoff accepted by the authorized publisher): mark item published and pass to Generate Qualified Demand for website/waitlist CTA routing.
6. On failure: record failure reason, item id, and next action; do not retry indefinitely; escalate when rules say so.
7. Never expand permissions to auto-post without a new founder-approved grant.
jobs.decision_logic:
- IF Approval is not approve, THEN refuse to publish.
- IF artifact was edited after approval, THEN return to Route Publishing Approval — do not publish stale approval.
- IF channel is email and sending domain is missing, THEN completion = documented blocked handoff (failure under defined rules), not a silent skip.
- IF platform post fails externally, THEN record failure and ESCALATE WHEN founder must decide retry vs revise.
- IF requested to have SVOS/agents post via undeclared credentials, THEN refuse (prohibited).
- ESCALATE WHEN a new external write grant or automation activation is required.
jobs.outputs: Per-item publish handoff record: success (external publish confirmed) or documented failure/blocked status, with destination channel and next Job link.
jobs.destinations: Marketing 05 Content publish log; Generate Qualified Demand (on success); Approvals queue (on failure/blocked); GTM Project reflection.
jobs.updates: Item publish status; GTM automation boundaries honored; demand-routing trigger for successful items.
jobs.validation:
- Approval verified before handoff
- No undeclared credential use
- Email blocked state explicit when domain missing
- Success/failure recorded per item
- No canonical truth altered
jobs.approval: Founder Approval already obtained via Route Publishing Approval. This Job does not re-approve content; it governs execution handoff. Activating any auto-publish automation requires separate founder approval (Approval Rules).
jobs.exceptions: Platform outage: record failure and stop. Missing domain for email: documented blocked completion. Unauthorized tool requesting production write: refuse and escalate.

permissions.allowed_reads: Approval records; approved drafts; Integration Brain; GTM and Landing Page Projects; Approval Rules.
permissions.allowed_writes: Publish handoff/status records inside Marketing Content destinations.
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Storing platform credential values in SVOS
- Auto-posting without founder-approved automation grant
- Publishing without Approval=approve
- Database/waitlist writes
- Expanding agent authority

jobs.completion_condition: Every approved item has either (a) a successful governed handoff to the authorized publishing destination with external publish confirmed, or (b) a documented failure/blocked outcome under these rules — then successful items are handed to Generate Qualified Demand.
jobs.improvement_loop: Repeated publish failures by channel update exceptions and preconditions; founder corrections to handoff procedure update this Job.
jobs.dry_run: Allowed: prepare handoff packages without external post. Live external post requires Approval=approve and authorized publisher.
jobs.escalate_when: Auto-publish grant requested, credentials would be stored in-repo, or failures require founder retry/revise decision.

jobs.name: Capture Marketing Improvement
jobs.purpose: Capture founder corrections, publish/routing failures, and funnel learnings into recorded Marketing improvements so the acquisition loop gets better without silent change.
jobs.trigger: Founder red-pen accepted as lasting correction; Publish Approved Content or Generate Qualified Demand failure pattern; Funnel and Demand Report shows a threshold breach; or end of Executive Review of this loop.
jobs.inputs:
- Founder feedback / red-pen notes
- Failure records from Publish / Demand Routing
- Funnel report outcomes
- Prepare Founder Brief actions (if any)
jobs.required_sources:
- [[04 Knowledge/Marketing/Voice Guide]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Founder Directives]]
- This loop's Job definitions (plan/produce/approve/publish/demand)
- Funnel and Demand Report output
- Prepare Founder Brief output when present
jobs.preconditions:
- A concrete correction or failure exists (not a vague vibe).
- Improvement will be written to Marketing Improvements — not only chat.
jobs.execution:
1. Record the improvement: source (founder / failure / metric), affected Job(s), and proposed change.
2. IF the correction is voice law the founder accepted, THEN route Voice Guide update with date (Founder Directives red-pen rule) — do not only patch a Job.
3. IF the correction is procedural, THEN propose the exact Job field updates for the next enrichment pass.
4. IF the issue is an external blocker (domain, deploy, UTM), THEN record it as Project/Integration gap — do not invent a System fix.
5. Link improvements back to Prioritize Projects / plan inputs when they change ranking or calendar assumptions.
6. Do not silently edit locked Knowledge.
jobs.decision_logic:
- IF feedback is one-run only, THEN store as Job lesson — not Voice Guide.
- IF feedback is accepted voice law, THEN Voice Guide update path.
- IF change would alter Constitution/ADR/compiler, THEN stop — kernel changes are out of scope; escalate as architecture request.
- ESCALATE WHEN founder must approve Knowledge updates or priority changes.
jobs.outputs: A recorded Marketing improvement item with owner, affected objects, and next action.
jobs.destinations: Marketing 17 Improvements; Voice Guide (when red-pen accepted); relevant Job improvement_loop notes for next enrichment.
jobs.updates: Improvements log; optional Voice Guide dated correction; loop Jobs queued for enrichment if procedure changed.
jobs.validation:
- Improvement written down
- Affected objects named
- Voice vs procedure vs external-blocker classified
- No silent kernel or locked-fact edits
jobs.approval: Voice Guide and locked directive updates require founder confirmation. Procedural Job enrichments follow normal authoring + founder commit approval.
jobs.exceptions: If feedback is ambiguous, ask the founder one clarifying question — do not guess. If proposed change needs a new Business System, refuse and escalate.

permissions.allowed_reads: Loop outputs; Voice Guide; Founder Directives; Funnel report; Founder Brief.
permissions.allowed_writes: Marketing Improvements records; draft Voice Guide corrections awaiting founder confirmation.
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Silent edits to locked Knowledge
- Kernel/ADR changes
- New Business Systems
- Production writes

jobs.completion_condition: Improvement is recorded with classification and next action; accepted voice corrections are queued for Voice Guide with date.
jobs.improvement_loop: This Job improves the loop that improves Marketing — meta-corrections update its own triggers and classification rules.
jobs.escalate_when: Change would modify governing documents or require a new System.

metrics.name: Qualified Demand Generated
metrics.definition: Count of beauty professionals captured on the production waitlist, reportable by career stage when the funnel report source provides stage splits.
metrics.type: Marketing demand outcome metric (not Analytics System authority — Analytics BS-004 deferred).
metrics.formula: Total waitlist signups in the reporting period; optionally broken down by career stage when stage is present in the source extract.
metrics.source: Production waitlist via the data platform recorded in [[04 Knowledge/Integrations/Integration Brain]] (founder-approved read path / daily brief funnel section). Per-platform attribution: `NOT IN SOURCE` (UTM/source field blocked per GTM Project).
metrics.cadence: Daily (align with GTM funnel report / daily brief) and weekly for Executive Review.
metrics.action: On founder-defined threshold breach (when targets exist), route to Prepare Founder Brief and Capture Marketing Improvement. Until targets exist, report the number without inventing status colors.
metrics.measured_object: Professional waitlist signups (Landing Page / GTM funnel).
metrics.improvement_link: Capture Marketing Improvement; Prioritize Projects when acquisition priority must change.

automations.name: Content Drafting Pipeline
automations.purpose: Daily dry-run automation that executes Produce Content to draft the multi-platform queue for founder red-pen — drafts only; never posts or sends.
automations.trigger: Daily schedule (GTM Project: content-pipeline pattern at 07:45 local) or founder manual run.
automations.schedule: Daily — align with GTM Project content-pipeline runner cadence when executed externally.
automations.tools: SVOS-compiled Produce Content definition; external vault-write-only runner when used (referenced-external). No platform posting APIs.
automations.credential_refs: No credentials required for vault-write-only drafting. Never store secret values here. Platform posting credentials: prohibited for this automation.

permissions.allowed_reads: Produce Content required sources; content plan; Marketing Knowledge.
permissions.allowed_writes: Draft queue only (Marketing Content destinations and/or vault-write-only external path).
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Publishing or posting to any platform
- Sending email
- Production/database writes
- Activating without dry_run
- Expanding permissions

automations.allowed_reads: Produce Content required sources; content plan; Marketing Knowledge.
automations.prohibited_actions:
- Publishing or posting
- Sending email
- Production/database writes
- Permission expansion
automations.dry_run: Required. Always draft-only. Live publish/send paths are forbidden.
automations.approval_gate: Founder approval required before activating this automation beyond dry-run drafting. Publishing remains a separate founder Approval via Route Publishing Approval.
automations.monitoring: Confirm a draft queue artifact was produced; confirm zero publish/send side effects.
automations.retries: On failure, do not retry publish paths (none exist). Retry draft generation once after missing-source fix; then escalate to founder.
automations.rollback: Delete or archive failed draft batch; do not touch live platforms (no live writes authorized).
automations.disable_procedure: Set enabled=false in this definition; disable external runner schedule; leave Approvals queue untouched.
automations.status: Proposed; inactive until founder approves activation (dry-run drafting may be tested under explicit founder instruction).
automations.inputs: Content plan; Marketing Knowledge; GTM Project constraints (drafts only).

automations.name: Funnel and Demand Report
automations.purpose: Produce the stage-level waitlist funnel report that measures Qualified Demand Generated for Executive Review — without inventing per-platform attribution.
automations.trigger: Daily schedule aligned with GTM funnel report / daily brief; or before Prepare Founder Brief.
automations.schedule: Daily when external brief/funnel extract is available.
automations.tools: Founder-approved read path to waitlist counts / daily brief funnel section; SVOS metric Qualified Demand Generated definition. No UTM invention.
automations.credential_refs: Use existing approved read credentials by reference only (e.g. Management API read_only path when used externally). Never store token values in SVOS input.

permissions.allowed_reads: Waitlist aggregate counts by career stage when provided by approved extract; GTM Project; Qualified Demand Generated definition; demand-routing records.
permissions.allowed_writes: Funnel report artifacts in Marketing destinations / brief inputs.
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Non-read database access
- Inventing UTM/per-platform splits
- Writing waitlist rows
- Expanding permissions

automations.allowed_reads: Waitlist stage counts from approved extract; GTM Project; demand-routing records.
automations.prohibited_actions:
- Waitlist writes
- Inventing attribution
- Permission expansion
automations.dry_run: Allowed: build report scaffold from last known extract without new queries.
automations.approval_gate: Founder approval required before activating unattended live querying beyond existing approved brief/snapshot grants.
automations.monitoring: Report produced; stage split present or explicitly `NOT IN SOURCE`; zero write side effects.
automations.retries: Retry read once on transient failure; then escalate. Never retry with broader permissions.
automations.rollback: Discard failed report draft; do not alter source data.
automations.disable_procedure: Set enabled=false; stop schedule; leave last good report archived.
automations.status: Proposed; inactive until founder approves activation against an approved read path.
automations.inputs: Demand-routing records; waitlist stage counts extract; metric definition.

folders.purpose: Understand the prospective market and audience; distinct from existing customers.

folders.title: Demand Generation
folders.purpose: Generate and qualify demand; hand qualified demand to the capture system and future Sales.

folders.title: Market Sensing
folders.purpose: Sense the market and competitive landscape to inform perception; not the canonical measurement authority (Analytics).

folders.title: Reputation

folders.title: Campaigns
folders.purpose: Plan and produce campaigns; their cross-system movement is coordinated by Operations.

folders.title: Approvals
folders.purpose: Route Marketing items requiring founder approval before publishing; Marketing routes, the founder decides.
